title: Continuity of the concrete geometric-point Galois action
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure of K, G=Gal(Ksep/K) with its Krull topology, and X an etale K-scheme [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Put P(X)=Hom_K(Spec Ksep,X), with discrete topology and the left G-action g.x=Spec(g) followed by x. This action is continuous. The module constructs this action explicitly, including its unit and multiplication laws.

source.place: Tag 03QR, Lemma lemma-sheaves-point; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QR; first paragraph (open stabilizers), expanded by the finite-type affine-neighborhood argument implemented in Lean

proof.text: Factor any geometric point x through an affine open immersion j:Spec R -> X around its image. Since Spec Ksep has one point, its image lies entirely in this neighborhood. The composite Spec R -> X -> Spec K is locally of finite type; therefore R is a finitely generated K-algebra. The factor l:Spec Ksep -> Spec R corresponds to a K-algebra map a:R -> Ksep.

Choose a finite algebra generating set s for R. An automorphism g fixes a if and only if it fixes a(r) for every r in s: the reverse implication is AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top. Thus the stabilizer is the finite intersection of the stabilizers of these images. Each image is integral over K because Ksep/K is separable algebraic; stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral in Mathlib proves its stabilizer open. The finite intersection is open.

The open immersion j is a monomorphism, so g fixes x=l followed by j if and only if it fixes l, equivalently the algebra map a. The preceding open subset is therefore the geometric-point stabilizer. Apply Mathlib continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen for the discrete topology. Empty X is vacuous.
